notes: EDGE CASE: borderline OFF_MARKET_SALE vs COMING_SOON_SALE. The email uses 'off-market' AND 'before we decide whether to launch', but the operative fact is it is AVAILABLE TO SHOW NOW and privately marketed - which is OFF_MARKET_SALE, not coming soon. True category is OFF_MARKET_SALE. Lower confidence floor for the ambiguity. Address/price clean.

input.subject: LES - off-market, showable now (may or may not list later)
input.bodyText:
Hi all,

A little unusual - owner is happy to sell now if the right buyer shows up privately, but hasn't committed to a public launch. So think of this as off-market and available today, not a coming soon with a set on-market date.

171 Ludlow St, Unit 4F (Lower East Side)
2BR / 1BA condo, ~940 sf, boutique elevator building, private roof cabana
Asking $1,850,000

Showable this week to pre-qualified buyers. If nothing lands we may formally list in September, but no promises and no MLS right now. Co-broke 2.5%.

Aisha Rahman
Compass
